```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Interactive (plotly) dashboard of the saved ice-model outputs, following the
# sections of Antarctica_to_Rockies_Comparison_Presentation.Rmd.
#
# It only READS the saved outputs in Data/model_outputs/; it does not re-run
# the models. To refresh it after changing R/functions/, knit
# Antarctica_to_Rockies_Comparison_Presentation.Rmd (rerun_models: true) first,
# then knit this file.
#
# Every chart: drag to zoom, double-click to reset, click a legend entry to
# hide it (double-click to show only that one), camera icon saves a PNG.

path <- path.expand("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UCB-O365/Documents/R-Repositories/TVLakes_IceModel")
if (!dir.exists(path)) stop("Repository folder not found: ", path)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "–")

source(file.path(path, "R/functions/libraries.R"))
source(file.path(path, "R/functions/functions.R"))
pacman::p_load(plotly, flexdashboard)
# plotly masks dplyr::filter and graphics::layout; be explicit
filter <- dplyr::filter
layout <- plotly::layout
```

```{r data}
# ---- Lakes ------------------------------------------------------------------
lakes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~lake_key, ~region,               ~output_file,
  "WLB",     "McMurdo Dry Valleys", "Data/model_outputs/WLB_2017_2024_output.csv",
  "ELB",     "McMurdo Dry Valleys", "Data/model_outputs/ELB_2017_2024_output.csv",
  "LH",      "McMurdo Dry Valleys", "Data/model_outputs/LH_2017_2024_output.csv",
  "LF",      "McMurdo Dry Valleys", "Data/model_outputs/LF_2017_2024_output.csv",
  "GL4",     "Colorado Rockies",    "Data/model_outputs/GL4_2014_2025_output.csv",
  "LOC",     "Colorado Rockies",    "Data/model_outputs/LOC_2017_2024_output.csv"
)
lakes <- lakes[file.exists(file.path(path, lakes$output_file)), ]
keys      <- lakes$lake_key
dv_keys   <- intersect(c("WLB", "ELB", "LH", "LF"), keys)
rk_keys   <- intersect(c("GL4", "LOC"), keys)
lake_name <- purrr::map_chr(LAKE_CONFIGS[keys], "lake_name")
region_of <- setNames(lakes$region, keys)
# Okabe–Ito: same lake colours as the report
lake_cols <- setNames(c("#0072B2", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "#E69F00", "#D55E00"),
                      c("WLB", "ELB", "LH", "LF", "GL4", "LOC"))[keys]

flux_vars <- c(SW_abs       = "Absorbed shortwave",
               LW_net       = "Net longwave",
               sensible_Q   = "Sensible heat",
               latent_Q     = "Latent heat",
               conductive_Q = "Conductive (−Qc)")
flux_cols <- setNames(c("#E69F00", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7"), flux_vars)

# ---- Model output and observations ------------------------------------------
results <- purrr::map(file.path(path, lakes$output_file), readr::read_csv,
                      show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  purrr::set_names(keys)

ice_obs <- purrr::imap(results, function(res, key) {
  load_ice_observations(key, project_path = path, time_range = range(res$time, na.rm = TRUE))
})

# Daily summaries. Fluxes are averaged over ice-covered hours only (as in the
# report), so the open-water season at the Rockies lakes is left out.
daily <- purrr::imap_dfr(results, function(res, key) {
  if (!"phase" %in% names(res)) res$phase <- "ice"
  res |>
    dplyr::mutate(day = as.Date(time), on_ice = phase == "ice",
                  conductive_Q = -conductive_Q) |>
    dplyr::group_by(day) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      thickness    = mean(thickness, na.rm = TRUE),
      surface_loss = sum(surface_loss, na.rm = TRUE),
      bottom_gain  = sum(bottom_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(names(flux_vars)),
                    ~ if (any(on_ice)) mean(.x[on_ice], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_),
      net_flux     = if (any(on_ice)) mean(surface_heat_flux[on_ice], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop") |>
    # rounding keeps the embedded plot data (and the HTML file) small
    dplyr::mutate(thickness = round(thickness, 3),
                  dplyr::across(c(dplyr::all_of(names(flux_vars)), net_flux), ~ round(.x, 1)),
                  lake_key = key)
})

obs_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(ice_obs, function(o, key) {
  if (is.null(o) || nrow(o) == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(lake_key = key, day = as.Date(o$date_time),
                 obs = abs(o$z_water_m), hole = o$location)
})

fit <- obs_all |>
  dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::select(daily, lake_key, day, model = thickness),
                    by = c("lake_key", "day")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(resid = model - obs, lake = lake_name[lake_key])

# ---- Shared plotly styling --------------------------------------------------
font_family <- "Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif"
finish <- function(p, hovermode = "closest", legend_y = 1.12, ...) {
  p <- plotly_build(p)
  # plotly repeats a constant hovertemplate once per point; collapse it so the
  # embedded data (and the HTML file) stays small
  p$x$data <- lapply(p$x$data, function(tr) {
    for (a in c("hovertemplate", "hoverinfo")) {
      u <- unique(Filter(Negate(is.null), as.list(tr[[a]])))
      if (length(tr[[a]]) > 1 && length(u) == 1) tr[[a]] <- u[[1]]
    }
    tr
  })
  p |>
    layout(font = list(family = font_family, size = 12, color = "#2b2b2b"),
           hovermode = hovermode,
           legend = list(orientation = "h", y = legend_y, x = 0),
           margin = list(l = 60, r = 20, t = 30, b = 40),
           paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", ...) |>
    config(displaylogo = FALSE,
           modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d", "autoScale2d"),
           toImageButtonOptions = list(format = "png", scale = 3))
}
ax_y <- function(title, ...) list(title = title, zeroline = FALSE, gridcolor = "#e6e6e6", ...)
ax_x <- function(title = "", ...) list(title = title, zeroline = FALSE, gridcolor = "#e6e6e6", ...)
fade <- function(hex, a) { v <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex); sprintf("rgba(%d,%d,%d,%.2f)", v[1], v[2], v[3], a) }
month_axis <- ax_x(tickvals = 1:12, ticktext = month.abb)

# One flexdashboard tab per lake: knits `fun("<key>")` under a ### heading
lake_tabs <- function(fun, tab_keys = keys) {
  src <- unlist(lapply(tab_keys, function(k) c(
    sprintf("### %s", lake_name[[k]]), "",
    "```{r}", sprintf("%s('%s')", fun, k), "```", "")))
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = src, quiet = TRUE, envir = globalenv()), sep = "\n")
}
```

### Summary by lake

```{r}
n_years <- function(d) as.numeric(diff(range(d))) / 365.25
lake_summary <- daily |>
  dplyr::group_by(lake_key) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Start = min(day), End = max(day),
                   `Mean thickness (m)` = mean(thickness),
                   `Min (m)` = min(thickness), `Max (m)` = max(thickness),
                   `Surface melt (m/yr)` = sum(surface_loss) / n_years(day),
                   `Bottom growth (m/yr)` = sum(bottom_gain) / n_years(day),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::left_join(fit |>
                     dplyr::group_by(lake_key) |>
                     dplyr::summarise(`Obs (n)` = dplyr::n(),
                                      `Bias (m)` = mean(resid),
                                      `RMSE (m)` = sqrt(mean(resid^2)), .groups = "drop"),
                   by = "lake_key") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Lake = lake_name[lake_key], Region = region_of[lake_key],
                lake_key = factor(lake_key, levels = keys)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(lake_key) |>
  dplyr::select(Lake, Region, Start, End, dplyr::everything(), -lake_key)

knitr::kable(lake_summary, digits = 2, format = "html",
             table.attr = 'class="table table-sm table-hover"')
```

```{r}
region_thickness <- function(region_keys) {
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (k in region_keys) {
    d <- dplyr::filter(daily, lake_key == k)
    o <- dplyr::filter(obs_all, lake_key == k)
    p <- p |>
      add_lines(data = d, x = ~day, y = ~thickness, name = lake_name[[k]], legendgroup = k,
                line = list(color = lake_cols[[k]], width = 1.6),
                hovertemplate = "%{x|%Y-%m-%d}<br>Model %{y:.2f} m<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>")
    if (nrow(o) > 0)
      p <- p |>
        add_markers(data = o, x = ~day, y = ~obs, name = paste(lake_name[[k]], "(observed)"),
                    legendgroup = k, showlegend = FALSE,
                    marker = list(color = lake_cols[[k]], size = 7, line = list(color = "white", width = 1)),
                    hovertemplate = "%{x|%Y-%m-%d}<br>Observed %{y:.2f} m<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>")
  }
  p |> finish(yaxis = ax_y("Ice thickness (m)"), xaxis = ax_x(rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE)))
}
```

```{r}
lake_thickness_plot <- function(k) {
  d <- dplyr::filter(daily, lake_key == k)
  o <- dplyr::filter(obs_all, lake_key == k)
  p1 <- plot_ly(d, x = ~day) |>
    add_lines(y = ~thickness, name = "Modelled (daily mean)", line = list(color = "#2166AC", width = 1.8),
              hovertemplate = "Model %{y:.2f} m<extra></extra>")
  if (nrow(o) > 0)
    p1 <- p1 |>
      add_markers(data = o, x = ~day, y = ~obs, name = "Observed depth to water", text = ~hole,
                  marker = list(color = "#D6604D", size = 8, line = list(color = "white", width = 1)),
                  hovertemplate = "Observed %{y:.2f} m<br>%{text}<extra></extra>")
  wk <- d |>
    dplyr::mutate(week = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(day, "week"))) |>
    dplyr::group_by(week) |>
    dplyr::summarise(surface = round(-sum(surface_loss) * 100, 2),
                     bottom  = round(sum(bottom_gain) * 100, 2), .groups = "drop")
  p2 <- plot_ly(wk, x = ~week) |>
    add_bars(y = ~surface, name = "Surface melt", marker = list(color = "#E69F00"),
             hovertemplate = "Surface %{y:.2f} cm<extra></extra>") |>
    add_bars(y = ~bottom, name = "Bottom growth / melt", marker = list(color = "#0072B2"),
             hovertemplate = "Bottom %{y:+.2f} cm<extra></extra>")
  subplot(p1, p2, nrows = 2, shareX = TRUE, heights = c(0.68, 0.32), titleY = TRUE) |>
    finish(hovermode = "x unified", barmode = "relative", bargap = 0,
           yaxis = ax_y("Ice thickness (m)"), yaxis2 = ax_y("Weekly change (cm)"),
           xaxis = ax_x())
}
```

```{r meas-prep}
ice_raw <- readr::read_csv(file.path(path, "Data/mcmlter-lake-ice_thickness-20250218_0_2025.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
meas <- purrr::map_dfr(dv_keys, function(key) {
  cfg <- LAKE_CONFIGS[[key]]
  d <- dplyr::filter(ice_raw, location_name == cfg$lake_name)
  if (is.function(cfg$ice_loc_filter)) d <- cfg$ice_loc_filter(d)
  d <- exclude_ice_holes(d)
  rng <- range(dplyr::filter(daily, lake_key == key)$day)
  d |>
    dplyr::transmute(lake_key = key,
                     day     = as.Date(lubridate::parse_date_time(date_time, c("mdy HM", "mdy HMS", "mdy"))),
                     hole    = trimws(location),
                     z_water = abs(as.numeric(z_water_m)),
                     z_ice   = as.numeric(z_ice_m)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(day), day >= rng[1], day <= rng[2])
})
fb_mean <- meas |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(z_water), !is.na(z_ice)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(lake_key) |>
  dplyr::summarise(fb_mean = mean(z_ice - z_water), .groups = "drop")
meas_long <- meas |>
  dplyr::left_join(fb_mean, by = "lake_key") |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(daily, lake_key, day, model = thickness), by = c("lake_key", "day")) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(model)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(z_water, z_ice), names_to = "type", values_to = "obs") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(obs)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(resid = ifelse(type == "z_ice", model + fb_mean, model) - obs,
                type  = c(z_water = "Depth to water (z_water)",
                          z_ice   = "Total thickness (z_ice) vs model + mean freeboard")[type])
meas_cols <- c("Depth to water (z_water)" = "#D55E00",
               "Total thickness (z_ice) vs model + mean freeboard" = "#009E73")
```

```{r}
    p <- p |>

                  text = ~hole, marker = list(color = meas_cols[[t]], size = 7, opacity = 0.85,
                                              symbol = if (grepl("^Depth", t)) "circle" else "triangle-up"),
                  hovertemplate = "%{x|%Y-%m-%d} · %{text}<br>%{y:+.2f} m<extra></extra>")
  }
  p |> layout(yaxis = ax_y("", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "#888888"),
              annotations = list(list(text = paste0("<b>", lake_name[[k]], "</b>"), x = 0, y = 1,
                                      xref = "paper", yref = "paper", xanchor = "left", yanchor = "top",
                                      showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 11))))
})
subplot(panels, nrows = length(panels), shareX = TRUE, margin = c(0, 0, 0.03, 0.03)) |>
  finish(legend_y = 1.08, xaxis = ax_x(),
         annotations = list(list(text = "Model − observed (m)", textangle = -90, x = -0.06, y = 0.5,
                                 xref = "paper", yref = "paper", showarrow = FALSE)))
```

Energy fluxes
=====================================================================

```{r flux-stats}
flux_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(results, function(res, key) {
  if (!"phase" %in% names(res)) res$phase <- "ice"
  res |>
    dplyr::filter(phase == "ice") |>
    dplyr::mutate(conductive_Q = -conductive_Q, month = lubridate::month(time)) |>
    dplyr::select(month, dplyr::all_of(names(flux_vars))) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-month, names_to = "flux_key", values_to = "value") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(lake_key = key)
}) |>
  dplyr::mutate(flux = factor(flux_vars[flux_key], levels = flux_vars))

flux_summary <- flux_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(lake_key, flux) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_signed = mean(value), mean_abs = mean(abs(value)), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(lake = factor(lake_name[lake_key], levels = lake_name))
flux_net <- flux_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(lake) |>
  dplyr::summarise(net = sum(mean_signed), .groups = "drop")

flux_monthly <- flux_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(lake_key, flux, month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(lo = unname(quantile(value, 0.10)), hi = unname(quantile(value, 0.90)),
                   value = mean(value), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 24 * 10)          # need >= 10 days of ice in that month
```

Row {data-height=40}
---------------------------------------------------------------------

All fluxes in W m⁻², ice-covered hours only. Positive adds energy to the ice surface. Net surface flux = absorbed SW + net LW + sensible + latent − Q<sub>c</sub>.

```{r}
p <- plot_ly()
for (f in flux_vars)

             marker = list(color = flux_cols[[f]]),
             hovertemplate = "%{x}<br>%{y:.1f} W m⁻²<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>")
p |> finish(barmode = "group", xaxis = ax_x(), yaxis = ax_y("Mean |flux| (W m⁻²)", type = "log"))
```

### What adds and removes energy? (mean signed flux; ◆ = net)

```{r}
p <- plot_ly()
for (f in flux_vars)
  p <- p |>
    add_bars(data = dplyr::filter(flux_summary, flux == f), y = ~lake, x = ~mean_signed, name = f,
             orientation = "h", marker = list(color = flux_cols[[f]]),
             hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>%{x:+.1f} W m⁻²<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>")
p |>
  add_markers(data = flux_net, y = ~lake, x = ~net, name = "Net surface flux",
              marker = list(symbol = "diamond", size = 12, color = "#111111",
                            line = list(color = "white", width = 1.5)),
              hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>Net %{x:+.1f} W m⁻²<extra></extra>") |>
  finish(barmode = "relative", xaxis = ax_x("W m⁻²", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "#666666"),
         yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed"))
```

```{r}
flux_month_plot <- function(k) {
  d <- dplyr::filter(flux_monthly, lake_key == k)
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (f in flux_vars) {
    df <- dplyr::filter(d, flux == f)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) next
    df <- tidyr::complete(df, month = 1:12)      # gaps (open water) break the line
    p <- p |>
      add_ribbons(data = df, x = ~month, ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi, name = f, legendgroup = f,
                  showlegend = FALSE, fillcolor = fade(flux_cols[[f]], 0.15),
                  line = list(width = 0), hoverinfo = "skip") |>
      add_trace(data = df, x = ~month, y = ~value, name = f, legendgroup = f,
                type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
                line = list(color = flux_cols[[f]], width = 2), marker = list(color = flux_cols[[f]], size = 6),
                customdata = ~cbind(lo, hi),
                hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f} W m⁻² (10–90%%: %{customdata[0]:.0f} to %{customdata[1]:.0f})<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>")
  }
  p |> finish(hovermode = "x unified", xaxis = month_axis,
              yaxis = ax_y("W m⁻²", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "#888888"))
}
```

```{r}
flux_daily_plot <- function(k) {
  d <- dplyr::filter(daily, lake_key == k) |>
    dplyr::mutate(day = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(day, "week"))) |>
    dplyr::group_by(day) |>
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(c(dplyr::all_of(names(flux_vars)), net_flux),
                                   ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 1)), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-day, ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x)))
  p <- plot_ly(d, x = ~day)
  for (i in seq_along(flux_vars))
    p <- p |>
      add_lines(y = d[[names(flux_vars)[i]]], name = flux_vars[[i]],
                line = list(color = flux_cols[[i]], width = 1),
                hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f}<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>")
  p |>
    add_lines(y = ~net_flux, name = "Net surface flux", line = list(color = "#111111", width = 1.2),
              visible = "legendonly", hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f}<extra>Net</extra>") |>
    finish(hovermode = "x unified", xaxis = ax_x(rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE)),
           yaxis = ax_y("Weekly mean (W m⁻²)", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "#888888"))
}
```

Model inputs
=====================================================================

```{r forcing}
forcing_vars <- c(T_air = "Air temperature (°C)", SW_in = "Incoming SW (W m⁻²)",
                  LWR_in = "Incoming LW (W m⁻²)", LWR_out = "Outgoing LW (W m⁻²)",
                  wind = "Wind speed (m s⁻¹)", relative_humidity = "Relative humidity (%)",
                  pressure = "Air pressure (kPa)", albedo = "Albedo",
                  snow_depth = "Snow on ice (cm)")
forcing_files <- file.path(path, sprintf("Data/model_outputs/%s_forcing_daily.rds", keys))
forcing <- purrr::map2_dfr(forcing_files[file.exists(forcing_files)], keys[file.exists(forcing_files)],
                           ~ dplyr::mutate(readRDS(.x), lake_key = .y))
forcing_long <- forcing |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::any_of(names(forcing_vars)), names_to = "var", values_to = "value") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(value = dplyr::case_when(var == "T_air"      ~ value - 273.15,
                                         var == "pressure"   ~ value / 1000,
                                         var == "snow_depth" ~ value * 100,
                                         TRUE ~ value)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(lake_key, var) |>
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(round(value, 6)) > 1) |>      # drop constants
  dplyr::arrange(day, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(smooth = zoo::rollapply(value, 30, mean, na.rm = TRUE, fill = NA,
                                        partial = TRUE, align = "center"),
                week = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(day, "week"))) |>
  # weekly means keep the page light; the 30-day running mean is computed from
  # the daily values first, then sampled weekly
  dplyr::group_by(lake_key, var, week) |>
  dplyr::summarise(value = round(mean(value), 2), smooth = round(mean(smooth), 2), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::rename(day = week)

forcing_plot <- function(k) {
  d  <- dplyr::filter(forcing_long, lake_key == k)
  vs <- intersect(names(forcing_vars), unique(d$var))
  panels <- lapply(vs, function(v) {
    dv <- dplyr::filter(d, var == v)
    plot_ly(dv, x = ~day) |>
      add_lines(y = ~value, name = "Weekly mean", legendgroup = "weekly", showlegend = v == vs[1],
                line = list(color = "#c4c4c4", width = 0.8), hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f}<extra>weekly</extra>") |>
      add_lines(y = ~smooth, name = "30-day mean", legendgroup = "smooth", showlegend = v == vs[1],
                line = list(color = lake_cols[[k]], width = 1.8),
                hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f}<extra>30-day</extra>") |>
      layout(yaxis = ax_y(forcing_vars[[v]], titlefont = list(size = 11)))
  })
  subplot(panels, nrows = length(panels), shareX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE) |>
    finish(hovermode = "x unified", legend_y = 1.04, xaxis = ax_x())
}
```

```{r}
})
```

```{r profiles}
prof_files <- file.path(path, sprintf("Data/model_outputs/%s_thermal_profile.rds", keys))
have_prof  <- file.exists(prof_files)
profiles <- purrr::map2_dfr(prof_files[have_prof], keys[have_prof],
                            ~ dplyr::mutate(readRDS(.x), lake_key = .y)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(depth = round(depth / CONSTANTS$dx) * CONSTANTS$dx,
                month = lubridate::month(time),
                nh_month = ifelse(lake_key %in% dv_keys, (month + 5) %% 12 + 1, month),
                season = factor(c("Winter", "Winter", "Spring", "Spring", "Spring", "Summer", "Summer",
                                  "Summer", "Autumn", "Autumn", "Autumn", "Winter")[nh_month],
                                levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn")))
season_cols <- c(Winter = "#0072B2", Spring = "#009E73", Summer = "#E69F00", Autumn = "#CC79A7")

prof_week <- profiles |>
  dplyr::mutate(week = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(time, "week"))) |>
  dplyr::group_by(lake_key, week, depth) |>
  dplyr::summarise(temp_C = round(mean(temp_C), 2), .groups = "drop")
temp_range <- range(prof_week$temp_C, na.rm = TRUE)

profile_heatmap <- function(k) {
  d <- dplyr::filter(prof_week, lake_key == k)
  plot_ly(d, x = ~week, y = ~depth, z = ~temp_C, type = "heatmap",
          colorscale = "Viridis", zmin = temp_range[1], zmax = 0,
          colorbar = list(title = "°C", len = 0.9),
          hovertemplate = "Week of %{x|%Y-%m-%d}<br>%{y:.1f} m below surface<br>%{z:.1f} °C<extra></extra>") |>
    finish(xaxis = ax_x(), yaxis = ax_y("Depth below ice surface (m)", autorange = "reversed"))
}
```

```{r}
panels <- lapply(pk, function(k) {

    if (nrow(d) == 0) next
    p <- p |>
      add_trace(data = d, x = ~lo, y = ~depth, type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
                line = list(width = 0), legendgroup = s, showlegend = FALSE, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
      add_trace(data = d, x = ~hi, y = ~depth, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", fill = "tonextx",
                fillcolor = fade(season_cols[[s]], 0.15), line = list(width = 0),
                legendgroup = s, showlegend = FALSE, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
      add_trace(data = d, x = ~temp, y = ~depth, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", name = s,
                legendgroup = s, showlegend = k == pk[1], line = list(color = season_cols[[s]], width = 2),
                hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} m: %{x:.1f} °C<extra>", s, "</extra>"))

  p |> layout(yaxis = list(autorange = "reversed"),

})
```

Albedo & lake levels
=====================================================================

```{r albedo}
alb_files <- list.files(file.path(path, "Data/model_outputs/albedo_comparison"),
                        pattern = "_(bb|wholelake)_output\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
has_alb <- length(alb_files) > 0
alb_src <- c(bb = "Blue box", wholelake = "Whole lake")
alb_cols <- c("Blue box" = "#0072B2", "Whole lake" = "#E69F00")
if (has_alb) {
  alb_daily <- purrr::map_dfr(alb_files, readr::read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(day = as.Date(time)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(lake_key, albedo_source, day) |>
    dplyr::summarise(thickness = round(mean(thickness), 3), albedo = round(mean(albedo), 3),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(source = alb_src[albedo_source])
}
alb_panels <- function(column, ytitle, summer_only = FALSE) {
  ks <- intersect(dv_keys, unique(alb_daily$lake_key))
  panels <- lapply(ks, function(k) {
    p <- plot_ly()
    for (s in alb_src) {
      d <- dplyr::filter(alb_daily, lake_key == k, source == s)
      if (summer_only) d <- dplyr::filter(d, lubridate::month(day) %in% c(10:12, 1:2))
      ht <- paste0("%{x|%Y-%m-%d}: %{y:.2f}<extra>", s, "</extra>")
      p <- if (summer_only) {
        add_markers(p, data = d, x = ~day, y = d[[column]], name = s, legendgroup = s,
                    showlegend = k == ks[1], marker = list(color = alb_cols[[s]], size = 3),
                    hovertemplate = ht)
      } else {
        add_lines(p, data = d, x = ~day, y = d[[column]], name = s, legendgroup = s,
                  showlegend = k == ks[1], line = list(color = alb_cols[[s]], width = 1.5),
                  hovertemplate = ht)
      }
    }
    if (column == "thickness") {
      o <- dplyr::filter(obs_all, lake_key == k)
      p <- p |> add_markers(data = o, x = ~day, y = ~obs, name = "Observed", legendgroup = "obs",
                            showlegend = k == ks[1], marker = list(color = "#222222", size = 6),
                            hovertemplate = "%{x|%Y-%m-%d}: %{y:.2f} m<extra>Observed</extra>")
    }
    p |> layout(yaxis = ax_y(lake_name[[k]]))
  })
  subplot(panels, nrows = length(panels), shareX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE) |>
    finish(legend_y = 1.06, xaxis = ax_x())
}
```

```{r}
lvl_file <- file.path(path, "Data/mcmlter-lake-levels-20260318.csv")

                  level = as.numeric(lake_level_masl)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(level), date >= as.Date("2012-10-01")) |>
    dplyr::arrange(date)
```
